notes: Thai is written without spaces between words: a line wrapped inside a sentence joins with NO space; sentences are separated by a space. Table 1 is the schedule (header row, full light grid). The numbered list uses typed Thai digits "๑." "๒." "๓." "๔."; the list "สิ่งที่ผู้สมัครจะได้รับ" uses bullets drawn by CSS (no marker in the text). Letterhead lines and the page line "หน้า ๑" are furniture.
